metadata.description: Personal agent skills, rules, subagents, commands and hooks in Hermes-style groups.

plugins.name: levistack
plugins.description: Every group: all skills, agents, commands and opt-in hooks.

plugins.name: levistack-agent-authoring
plugins.description: Creating agents, skills, rules, hooks, commands and AGENTS.md files for coding assistants.

plugins.name: levistack-architecture
plugins.description: System design and stack choices: super-architecture (detect, select, build, evaluate, migrate and document architecture), super-caching, Node backends, super-protobuf, target-stack evaluation and blueprints.

plugins.name: levistack-delivery
plugins.description: Shipping work: atomic commits, code review (local diff, request, receive, GitLab glab drafts), merge request descriptions, documentation (pages, API references, doc comments, docs checks after a change), tickets (sliced into end-to-end pieces with blockers) and API collections.

plugins.name: levistack-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering habits: tdd (test-first red-green-refactor across stacks), safe-refactor (behavior-preserving refactors), verify (evidence before claims), noslop (no-slop filter for backend, API, frontend, database, config and comments) and output-savers (YAGNI, DRY, SOLID and plain STE replies).

plugins.name: levistack-focus
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly daily tools: shrink a task to one next action, list tangents for later, and write today's standup from what you really did.

plugins.name: levistack-knowledge
plugins.description: Understand, question and plan: how the code works today (one flow or the whole repo), why it is shaped that way or why it broke (trace), a second opinion on a change, grilling plans, execution-ready API specs and step-by-step implementation plans.

plugins.name: levistack-product
plugins.description: Product and UI work, five jobs with one owner each: a design system and its tokens (design-system-kit), colors, themes and modes (color-kit), one screen or component with UX and motion (ui-ux-kit), polish and journey QA of a shipped product (product-polish-workflow), and a throwaway prototype or wireframe (prototype-wireframe). Covers mobile, desktop, web, TV and car.

plugins.name: levistack-workflow
plugins.description: How to work with this stack: the use-levistack entry point and router, finding and installing skills, and handing a session off to the next one.

plugins.name: polyglot-copywriter
plugins.description: Default writing skill for everyday prose: write, rewrite, humanize and de-AI text in simple words, 97 languages and 163 dialect overlays.

plugins.name: logo-kit-svg
plugins.description: Ship a four-file SVG brand system (icon and README banner, static and animated) plus a tiered kit: platform icons, social cards and boards, with script QA.
